invention.ref: Ernő Rubik develops his three-layer twisty puzzle in Budapest
invention.ref_zh: Ernő Rubik 在布达佩斯开发三阶旋转拼图

mass_production.ref: Launched on the Hungarian market as the Magic Cube
mass_production.ref_zh: 以 Magic Cube 名称在匈牙利上市

popularization.ref: Renamed Rubik’s Cube and launched internationally
popularization.ref_zh: 更名 Rubik’s Cube 并面向国际市场推出

locations.place_label_zh: 匈牙利布达佩斯（鲁比克的三阶魔方）

notes: 本条专指鲁比克的三阶机械旋转魔方，不涵盖更早的磁性二阶等其他旋转拼图。1975年为专利申请节点，不能与1977年授权日期混写。
notes_en: This entry covers Rubik’s mechanical 3×3 cube, not earlier magnetic 2×2 puzzles. His 1975 patent application should not be confused with the 1977 grant.
summary_zh: 1974 年 Ernő Rubik 在布达佩斯制作可旋转的三阶立方拼图，1977 年在匈牙利上市，1980 年以 Rubik’s Cube 之名推向世界。
summary_en: Ernő Rubik developed his twisty cube in Budapest in 1974. It reached Hungary’s market in 1977 and launched internationally as Rubik’s Cube in 1980.
